parsed.explanation: Part (i) of the refinement lemma is the write-up's only route to the universal upper bound (Section 4). The quoted sweep argument never defines the "two arrays", never shows the cancelled/uncancelled remnants form a multiset of at most s columns arising from at most s admissible splits of actual stick pieces, and never verifies the inductive hypothesis (at most s+1 members, total (T-d)/2) is met; the assertion about total lengths adding to T-d and "interchange at the cut" is stated, not proved. The only other reference is "proved in full in lemmas/refinement.md", an external file not contained in the text, which cannot be credited. Hence L3.2 is not established as written; a full proof of Lemma (i) (e.g. subset-sum pigeonhole plus mirrored-cut construction) is needed.
